name: Lionel
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:transformation)Dubbed "King of Beasts Transformation", Lionel is a belt Teigu transforming you into a half-beast lion with increased physical abilities and sharp senses. It grants exceptional vitality and regeneration, regrowing eyes and reattaching limbs while you have stamina. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master, can only be used by compatible people, and Lionel prefers free-spirited busty women.
